fieldValues.title: The declared checks never ran in CI
fieldValues.summary: The repository had a membership guard making a new conformance check impossible to land undeclared, and no gate making a declared check impossible to skip. 39 checks sat in the always tier and none of them ran on a pull request.
evidence: scripts/checks.json declares 39 entries in the always tier; before srs#576 the only PR-triggered workflow was Release Drift, which runs check-release-drift, check-gallery-conformance and the roadmap checks — not the registry (srs#576).
validate-all.mjs is a loop over the always-tier entries of checks.json and ran only when a human remembered to run it locally (srs#576).
The registry itself was ratified as the one declared home for every check in rfc-decision-19997e24 (srs#495).
fieldValues.body: This is the precondition for every other autonomy claim in the programme. Auto-merge on green is only meaningful if green means the declared checks actually ran; otherwise it is a promise an agent makes about itself.
